messages:
renee.c: hi team! i'm starting next week and had a few onboarding questions on payroll/benefits as an international hire: i don't have an SSN yet, my partner is a dependent but also no SSN, and i paid for a one-week hotel while moving in. can i get paid without SSN, enroll dependents, and submit relocation receipts now?

marta.hr: welcome, renee! :wave: short answers: 1) payroll can set up a temporary record without SSN while you apply for SSN/ITIN. 2) dependents can be added with passport + marriage/partnership cert while SSN pending. 3) yes submit relocation receipts now to Expensify and tag them as "Relocation - New Hire".

josh.payroll: adding payroll specifics: enter your bank details in Rippling and mark the SSN field "pending" if you haven't received it. we'll run payroll with a placeholder id to ensure direct deposit. once you provide the SSN/ITIN we will refile if any tax adjustments are necessary. expect first paycheck could be partial if you start mid-period.

oliver.benefits: from benefits carrier side: we can provision coverage based on passport + proof of relationship temporarily. final enrollment may require SSN later for claim processing. if the carrier needs it, we'll coordinate outreach. if there is any urgency for medical/dental in week 1, ping me and i'll try to expedite.

renee.c: thanks. about the hotel receipts  i have scanned receipts and credit card statements. what's the preferred file name/format? also paid tipping in cash, does that need a separate note?

expensify-bot: Reminder: Expense policy requires itemized receipts for lodging and transport. Photos are OK. For cash tips, add a short note with date and amount and attach any proof you have. Allowed file types: pdf, jpg, png.

josh.payroll: for naming we prefer: LastName_Relocation_YYYYMMDD (e.g., ReneeC_Relocation_20260115). attach each receipt separately and in Expensify choose category "Relocation - New Hire". if you need an advance for relocation, DM me with the amount and we can request manager approval.

renee.c: one more thing 12: if withholding is set without SSN will i be taxed at a higher default rate? wondering about large withholdings until SSN is updated.

marta.hr: withholding could be provisional based on completed W-4. if additional withholding occurs, payroll will correct retrospectively after SSN/ITIN is added and file necessary adjustments. it can take one or two cycles to process refunds. josh can explain timeline.

josh.payroll: typically corrections happen on next payroll cycle after we update records, but official tax refunds may take longer. we'll proactively monitor and keep you posted.

oliver.benefits: i'll flag your case with the carrier now and add a note that SSN is pending. renee, please upload passport + partnership cert to the secure HR folder and include a brief note that SSN pending so we don't reject initial enrollment.

renee.c: uploading now. appreciate the quick help! excited to join :tada:

marta.hr: great! checklist created for renee.c 12 tasks: verify docs, set temp payroll record, submit relocation expenses. owner: josh.payroll. due: 2 business days. ping us if anything blocks you. welcome aboard!
